meta.method: one object, one verdict, no bundle

GQ.name: Einstein
GQ.why: Universal. Everything with energy sources curvature the same way. One constant, G.

GQ.name: equivalence
GQ.object: g_μν (metric)  ↔  every matter worldline / kinetic term
GQ.why: The same metric enters every species. That is why gravity is not a fourth SM gauge click.

GQ.name: Lambda
GQ.why: Observed. Sits on the left of Einstein. Not derived from the SM vacuum.

GQ.name: QFT_on_curved
GQ.object: quantum fields ψ, A  ↔  classical g_μν
GQ.why: Hawking, inflation perturbations, etc. Fields are quantum. Geometry is not.

GQ.name: vacuum_to_gravity
GQ.why: This coupling is why ρ_Λ is a problem. Naive QFT vacuum overshoots the observed Λ by a huge factor. Not a pass.

GQ.name: hierarchy
GQ.why: Gravity is weak at v because M_Pl is huge. A fact. Not a derivation.

GQ.name: graviton_to_SM
GQ.why: Effective EFT exists (soft gravitons). A finite UV theory that outputs G and Λ is not on the desk.

GQ.name: gauge3_to_G
GQ.why: The screen: MSSM-class can meet the three gauges. None of them output G from that same map.

PUB.name: SM running (no extra stuff)
PUB.why: Baseline. The Standard Model does not unify the couplings.

PUB.name: Georgi–Glashow SU(5)
PUB.why: The original GUT. Publicly dead in its minimal form.

PUB.name: MSSM / SUSY SU(5) or SO(10)
PUB.why: Best-known 3-gauge program still standing. Does not output G_N or Λ.

PUB.name: Heterotic / type-II string landscape
PUB.why: Has gravity in the story. Does not hand you one F to the observed leftovers.

PUB.name: Asymptotic safety (gravity)
PUB.why: A gravity UV story. Not four-force unification.

PUB.name: Lisi E8
PUB.why: A published claim. Screened. Does not pass.

PUB.name: Loop quantum gravity / causal sets
PUB.why: Quantum geometry, not a four-force unifier.

PUB.name: This repo's reconstructed R / SFE knobs
PUB.why: Screened the same way. Score is not F. Cosmos export still missing.
